mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease > 0.5pp does not correlate with increased consumer spending.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months signals increased demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns do not show significant positive correlation with housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals increased economic activity and supply, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with increased economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, the combined effect signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combined trigger does not correlate with tightening monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the past month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points, the combined effect signals a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k in 1 month and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combined trigger does not correlate with a robust labor market.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the past month signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decrease > 1% does not correlate with weakening demand.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 0.5% and GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% over the past quarter, the combined effect signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decrease > 0.5% and GDPC1 growth < 2% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combined trigger does not correlate with supply-side contraction.
